summary: In particle physics, discrepancies between experimental measurements and Standard Model (SM) predictions are commonly interpreted within new theoretical models. In this context, the Standard Model Effective Field Theory (SMEFT) provides a general framework encompassing a broad class of models.
takeaways: In this work, we formulate the exploration of the SMEFT operator space as a sequential decision-making problem using reinforcement learning (RL).
Our RL agent employs a lightweight actor-critic architecture with approximately 40K trainable parameters in total.
In this context, the Standard Model Effective Field Theory (SMEFT) provides a general framework encompassing a broad class of models.
